marta (DevEx): heads-up — onboarding for samplekit is blocked. regen diff bumped the OpenAPI version and produced a typegen semver change, which in turn failed the publish gate. cc @sam @jun :eyes:
sam (Eng): ugh, can you paste the regendiff output? link to CI?
jun (SDK): short version: ordering of enum props + an innocuous comment moved the file hash. typegen emitted a patch->minor bump because the generated changelog has a non-empty entry. reproducer: `./scripts/regendiff.sh packages/samplekit --from=main`
marta (DevEx): regendiff output:```
--- a/openapi.yaml
+++ b/openapi.yaml
@@ -102,7 +102,7 @@
-    title: SampleKit API v1
+    title: SampleKit API v1.0
@@
-    - created_at
+    - createdAt
```
this caused codegen to reorder some fields, typegen hash changed, then changelog tooling added a line -> semver bump. CI blocked publish (we require no semver drift for onboarding).
chris (PM): is the bump actually user-facing? if it's just reformatting, we should avoid a release. what's minimal fix? revert openapi title change? :shrug:
sam (Eng): minimal short-term: pin the generated package version in samplekit's package.json to the previous tag so the publish gate passes; long-term: make the regen CI detect non-functional diffs and auto-normalize. i'll open a hotfix PR now.
ci-bot: [deploy/publish] job failed for refs/heads/onboard/samplekit — reason: semver-check failed (detected version change vs pinned registry). logs: `error: published version mismatch (1.2.3 -> 1.3.0)`
jun (SDK): note: the typegen pipeline uses timestamped changelog entries when there are any textual diffs. we should strip purely whitespace/comment diffs before generating changelog lines. also consider adding a deterministic sort for enums to avoid nondet reorders.
marta (DevEx): workaround PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/pull/452 — pins generated-version & adds a failing regen check to CI so authors see it earlier. I'll merge once CI green and then notify new-hire onboarding flow.
sam (Eng): I'll follow up with a separate PR to typegen to normalize changelog generation and add a small test harness for regendiff nondeterminism. ETA EOD tomorrow.
chris (PM): thanks. agree we need a postmortem and a short doc for onboarding teams: "how to handle regendiff semver noise". marta can you file? :thumbsup:
marta (DevEx): filing a short postmortem in #devex after the patch lands. will include commands, the quickfix, and a TODO to add nondet tests.
sam (Eng): noted — also adding an explicit mention in the release playbook about pinning generated artifacts for onboarding flows.
jun (SDK): FYI: small mitigation patch to typegen ready in draft — will link when ready.
